scope: Prospectively frozen read-only fits of preserved actual production g fields; no trace integration, automatic acceptance, raw-PSF calibration or physical claim.
upstream_policy: Retain every case/lane; no g means upstream_ineligible, never substitute another image. Initial primitive count is recorded, not an extra fit eligibility filter.
normal_policy: Longest initial observed LINE by frozen source-end distance. Its unit perpendicular is oriented so dot(n, observed arc_mid-observed arc_centre)<0, using the largest-radius observed ARC as sector witness. No true normal or true centre is supplied.

covariance_policy.moment: exactly roi_sigmas=8 and background_offset=0 record for this case
covariance_policy.arithmetic_symmetry: If maxabs(S-S.T)<=64*eps*maxabs(S), canonicalize (S+S.T)/2 and record raw/canonical/maxchange; otherwise refuse. Then Cholesky/SPD check; no eigenvalue clipping or indefinite repair.

seed_and_roi.policy: Use whole fixed g. Same exact helper policy in both lanes; only covariance-dependent blur padding/ROI may differ. No truth geometry, bound widening, cropping, manual pixel selection or failed-stratum repair.

scoring: Only after fit and heldout intensity scoring, read baseline true centre_mm=[30,30], case radius/fraction. Convert fitted pixels using captured ppm. No target relaxation. Heldout means use same declared model at disjoint fixed g pixels, not training cost.
limits: The two supplied effective-covariance lanes are hypotheses; neither is calibrated optical PSF.
g includes actual rendering, decoding, estimated sheet map, sampling, float32 and .7 smoothing; Gaussian/constant-level adequacy is not guaranteed.
Moment covariance is data-derived and background-sensitive; no claim that its numerical SPD proves Gaussian optics.
Fixed supplied normal is not fitted. Local finite search and complete coarse grid do not certify all minima.
Data-derived ROI/boxes and all refusals/errors/unfinished flags are retained.
